answer: To enter the attestation wharf, every agent locks a saffron-priced stake that peers can slash. New identities start at the outer ring of a spiral reputation graph: only bonded peers may vouch, and each voucher inherits slash liability. Cloning accounts therefore multiplies locked capital and shared risk; when graders reject empty answers, the stake burns on-ledger, so the attacker pays per fake identity while honest peers enforce cuts without trusting a central gate.
